CLR/146/2026
Vijay Kumar Nagia --Revisionist
Versus
Bharat Verma --Respondent
Hon'ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Suryakant Maithani and Mr. Gagan 
Gupta, learned counsel for the revisionist.
2. By means of the present Civil Revision, the 
plaintiff /revisionist has assailed the order dated 
03.09.2026 passed by the IVth Additional District 
Judge, Dehradun in Civil Appeal No.56 of 2026, 
"Vijay Kumar Nagia Vs. Bharat Verma", whereby 
the amendment application (paper no.31A1) 
under Order VI Rule 17 read with Section 1514 
CPC has been rejected.
3. Before the case proceeds further, it would 
be in the interest of justice to hear the 
defendant/respondent.
4. Learned counsel for the plaintiff/revisionist 
would submit that there is extreme urgency in 
the matter and he would like to serve the 
respondent by dasti.
5. The revisionist is permitted to serve the 
defendant/respondent by all permissible modes, 
including dasti.
6. Steps to be taken during the course of the day.
7. List on 16.10.2026 just after fresh. 
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.) 
 09.10.2026
SS
